summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on adjusting the frequency calculation for a specific market (India, JCD). Initially, [p1] proposed modifying `get_frequency_stage.sql` to apply a multiplier of 0.68 (with a minimum floor of 1) for a given company number.

After reviewing datasets, [p1] revised the request and asked for the frequency adjustment to be set using a multiplier of 1.38 on the stage.
[me] confirmed the change was implemented.
decisions: The frequency calculation for India (JCD) will use a multiplier of 1.38 on the stage.
